hypotheses.C0_manual_trace_is_exact: Every manual forward trace matches native logits within 1e-5.
hypotheses.C1_capacity_increases_operator_diversity: Layer-0 RMS-normalized effective rank increases monotonically with width in at least two of three seeds, and width 384 exceeds width 64 by at least 10 percent in those seeds.
hypotheses.C2_capacity_reduces_fractional_rank: The Layer-0 effective-rank-to-MLP-channel ratio is lower at width 384 than width 64 in every seed.
hypotheses.C3_late_answer_interface_remains_compact: Every width and seed has final-layer effective rank at most 25.
hypotheses.C4_exceptions_use_more_diverse_operators: Averaged over seeds, selected facts have at least 20 percent higher early-layer effective rank than unselected facts at every width.
hypotheses.C5_rule_exception_subspaces_separate_wit: The excess top-16 selected/unselected subspace overlap at width 384 is at most 80 percent of its width-64 value, averaged over seeds.
hypotheses.C6_depth_compresses_operator_families: Every width and seed has Layer-0 effective rank at least three times its final-layer effective rank.
